extraction.Name: Tails Tapio
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his 496.15 acre allotment, when it was issued, September 29,1919, for he did not want to pay taxes; but that the Indian Agency told him that, if he did not take it and pay the taxes, it would be assessed for taxes any way, and later sold for same; so he accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1922, he sold his 496.15 acres to Dari Ulrichs, for $6950.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes on his allotment
extraction.Occupation/Income: works on farms at common labor for his living; and that this is his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is not very good; has a wife and 6 children to support, and some of the children are sickly; did not sell his place for any debts incurred prior to the receipt of his patent in fee; taxes were paid out of the sale money; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; affidavit sworn December 27, 1928
